title: Xdrip shows wrong BG values - Bubble/libre
symptom: xDrip readings are way off (3-5 mmol higher) than Libre sensor or BG meter readings, even after recalibration. The issue recurs on latest stable and nightly versions, while Diabox app shows correct values.
evidence_quote: It's way off than Libre reading straight from the sensor or the Bubble. You can see what I mean in the picture, where xDrip BG could be 3-5 mmol higher, than the actual Libre or BG meter reading.
